name: OpenWrt Firewall Explorer v0.2.6 (Exact IP / CIDR)
description: Firewall explorer with optional exact IP and CIDR subnet filtering. No wildcards or regex.
template:
<Stack gap="sm">
<Group justify="space-between"><Text fw={700}>OpenWrt Firewall Explorer</Text><RefreshButton requestId="overview" size="xs" /></Group>
<Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Use the filters below, then click Load filtered events. Search runs on the collector, not in the browser.</Text>
<SimpleGrid cols={2} spacing="xs">
<Select bind="hours" defaultValue="24" label="Period" data={[{value:"1",label:"1 hour"},{value:"24",label:"24 hours"},{value:"168",label:"7 days"},{value:"720",label:"30 days"}]} />
<Select bind="zone" defaultValue="" label="Zone" data={[{value:"",label:"All"},{value:"wan",label:"WAN"},{value:"IoT",label:"IoT"},{value:"Guest",label:"Guest"},{value:"lan",label:"LAN"}]} />
<Select bind="action" defaultValue="" label="Action" data={[{value:"",label:"All"},{value:"DROP",label:"DROP"},{value:"REJECT",label:"REJECT"},{value:"BLOCK",label:"BLOCK"}]} />
<Select bind="direction" defaultValue="" label="Direction" data={[{value:"",label:"All"},{value:"INPUT",label:"INPUT"},{value:"OUTPUT",label:"OUTPUT"},{value:"FORWARD",label:"FORWARD"},{value:"INVALID_STATE",label:"INVALID_STATE"}]} />
<Select bind="proto" defaultValue="" label="Protocol" data={[{value:"",label:"All"},{value:"TCP",label:"TCP"},{value:"UDP",label:"UDP"},{value:"ICMP",label:"ICMP"},{value:"ICMPv6",label:"ICMPv6"}]} />
<TextInput bind="port" defaultValue="" label="Destination port" placeholder="443" />
<TextInput bind="src" defaultValue="" label="Source IP / CIDR" placeholder="192.168.1.0/24" />
<TextInput bind="dst" defaultValue="" label="Destination IP / CIDR" placeholder="192.168.50.0/24" />
</SimpleGrid>
<Select bind="page" defaultValue="0" label="Result page" data={[{value:"0",label:"Page 1"},{value:"30",label:"Page 2"},{value:"60",label:"Page 3"},{value:"90",label:"Page 4"},{value:"120",label:"Page 5"}]} />
<SubFetch requestId="filterEvents" trigger="manual" params={{hours:inputs.hours ?? "24",zone:inputs.zone ?? "",action:inputs.action ?? "",direction:inputs.direction ?? "",proto:inputs.proto ?? "",sourceIp:inputs.src ?? "",destinationIp:inputs.dst ?? "",port:inputs.port ?? "",limit:30,offset:inputs.page ?? "0"}}>
{(result, meta) => (<Stack gap="xs">
<SimpleGrid cols={2} spacing="xs"><Paper withBorder p="xs"><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Matching logged events</Text><Text fw={700} size="xl">{result?.count ?? 0}</Text></Paper><Paper withBorder p="xs"><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Events on this page</Text><Text fw={700} size="xl">{result?.events?.length ?? 0}</Text></Paper></SimpleGrid>
{result?.timeline?.length > 0 ? <LineChart h={190} data={result.timeline} dataKey="time" series={[{name:"DROP",color:"red.6"},{name:"REJECT",color:"orange.6"}]} curveType="linear" withLegend withTooltip /> : <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">No matching events in the chosen period.</Text>}
<Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Page starts at record {result?.offset ?? 0}. {result?.hasMore ? "More matches available: select the next page." : "End of results."}</Text>
<Text fw={600} size="sm">Matching events (newest first)</Text>
{result?.eventSlots?.event1 ? <Paper withBorder p="xs"><Group gap="xs"><Badge color={result?.eventSlots?.event1.action === "DROP" ? "red" : "orange"}>{result?.eventSlots?.event1.action}</Badge><Badge color="blue">{result?.eventSlots?.event1.zone}</Badge><Text size="xs">{result?.eventSlots?.event1.direction}</Text></Group><Text size="xs">{result?.eventSlots?.event1.src} → {result?.eventSlots?.event1.dst} · {result?.eventSlots?.event1.proto} / {result?.eventSlots?.event1.port || "—"}</Text><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">IN {result?.eventSlots?.event1.interfaceIn || "—"} · OUT {result?.eventSlots?.event1.interfaceOut || "—"} · {result?.eventSlots?.event1.reason}</Text></Paper> : null}

"red" : "orange"}>{result?.eventSlots?.event2.action}</Badge><Badge color="blue">{result?.eventSlots?.event2.zone}</Badge><Text size="xs">{result?.eventSlots?.event2.direction}</Text></Group><Text size="xs">{result?.eventSlots?.event2.src} → {result?.eventSlots?.event2.dst} · {result?.eventSlots?.event2.proto} / {result?.eventSlots?.event2.port || "—"}</Text><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">IN {result?.eventSlots?.event2.interfaceIn || "—"} · OUT {result?.eventSlots?.event2.interfaceOut || "—"} · {result?.eventSlots?.event2.reason}</Text></Paper> : null}

<Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Only events logged by OpenWrt are counted; logging is rate-limited. Synthetic HOMARR-FW-TEST events are excluded. Leave IP filters empty for any address. Supports exact IP or CIDR, not * or regex.</Text>
